instructions.en: Use transient_stability_cases. For each case compute the margins: angle_margin = angle_limit_deg - max_rotor_angle_deg; voltage_margin = min_voltage_pu - voltage_floor_pu; clearing_margin_s = estimated_cct_s - fault_clearing_time_s; damping_margin = damping_ratio_pct - min_damping_pct. A case is 'stable' only if all four margins are >= 0. Risk score (use exactly this formula): risk_score = max(0, -angle_margin/60) + max(0, -voltage_margin/0.1) + max(0, -clearing_margin_s/0.1) + max(0, -damping_margin/5) + max(0, 1 - clearing_margin_s/0.2)*0.1, rounded to 3 decimals. Report per-case label, risk_score, and clearing_margin_s; stable_case_count; and highest_risk_case (the largest risk_score, ties broken by the lexicographically larger case_id).
instructions.ru: Используйте transient_stability_cases. Для каждого кейса вычислите запасы: angle_margin = angle_limit_deg - max_rotor_angle_deg; voltage_margin = min_voltage_pu - voltage_floor_pu; clearing_margin_s = estimated_cct_s - fault_clearing_time_s; damping_margin = damping_ratio_pct - min_damping_pct. Кейс 'stable', только если все четыре запаса >= 0. Индекс риска (используйте ровно эту формулу): risk_score = max(0, -angle_margin/60) + max(0, -voltage_margin/0.1) + max(0, -clearing_margin_s/0.1) + max(0, -damping_margin/5) + max(0, 1 - clearing_margin_s/0.2)*0.1, округление до 3 знаков. Укажите по каждому кейсу label, risk_score и clearing_margin_s; stable_case_count; highest_risk_case (максимальный risk_score, при равенстве — лексикографически больший case_id).
